notes_for_editor: Only one page describes this site (Central US Lookouts): name, county, agency and legal location. Nothing in the cached pages or the pages I could open gives a build date, height, staffing, status or access, so the story is short: it covers the record's location and agency, general 1966 context, and today. The WebSearch budget for this run ran out after my first search for this site; I did not run a second search or any workaround. A search-enabled rerun may find a build history. Search snippets for an AllTrails route to a High Place Lookout Tower and a Missouri Life article were not used: AllTrails and Missouri Life returned HTTP 403 when opened. The 1966 counts are general Missouri context from MDC; that article does not name High Place. The record's agency and county match the page.
